_meta.description: Timestamped captures of the public leaderboard frontier (ranks 1, 50, 100, 250) and the displayed participant count. Each row is a moving snapshot, not a final threshold and not a prize guarantee. The public page exposes only ranks 1-250 while prizes extend through rank 300.
_meta.capture_granularity_note: The 2026-09-17 capture was read between roughly 00:25 and 00:35 UTC; the recorded timestamp is the midpoint of that window. Leaderboard values update no more than once per hour and rank by realized P/L, which only changes when a participant closes a position.
observed_notes: Rank 1 and rank 250 values were byte-identical across both captures (~3 hours apart, US after-hours).
The mid-board moved between captures: rank 50 changed holder and rose $28,139.75; rank 100 rose $11,027.50; the former rank 50 (chandu0342) held an identical value and slid to rank 53.
Displayed participants rose from 93,527 to 93,702 (+175) during a window in which registration remains open until 2026-09-23.
